description: Entity threat overrides for RotN 3.3.4, beyond the dump's `hostile` (= the class implements IMob). Read by catalog.entity(): `hostile` becomes true for every entry with targetsPlayers, and `dangerous` marks threats to avoid rather than fight. Every entry cites the mod's own bytecode.
method: javap -c -p (reads class files; no mod code is run) on the mod jars of the pinned server pack zip (SHA-256 90642fd5...f5205), extracted to a scratch folder outside the repo, 2026-11-01. Scope: every modded living entity whose class does not implement IMob (317 in the second dump). For each, the entity class and its mod superclasses were scanned for a targeting AI task (class name containing 'Target') whose constructor receives EntityPlayer.class; tasks that target EntityLivingBase with a predicate were reviewed by reading the predicate's apply(). EntityAIHurtByTarget (retaliation) is not counted. Conditions (added after the PR #62 review): for each entry, every branch instruction (if*, goto, *switch) before the task's `new` in the same method was checked for a jump target past the task, and the method's callers were checked: initEntityAI is called by EntityLiving's constructor; Undead Rising's func_175456_n is called from initEntityAI with no branch before the call; the death worm's task is in its own constructor. Only the grove sprite (onUpdate branch) is conditional among the marked entries.

confidence.verified: The bytecode shows players are targeted (an EntityPlayer target class without a predicate, or a predicate read and found to accept players).
confidence.task: A targeting task with EntityPlayer or EntityLivingBase as its target class; its predicate or shouldExecute was not inspected.
confidence.conditional: The player-targeting task is only added in some state.

alreadyHostileViaIMob: iceandfire:cyclops, iceandfire:if_hydra, iceandfire:gorgon, iceandfire:if_troll, iceandfire:stymphalianbird and iceandfire:siren implement IMob, so the dump already marks them hostile; they need no override.

betteranimalsplus:eel_freshwater.evidence: betteranimalsplus-1.12.2-9.0.1.jar: EntityFreshwaterEel extends EntityEelBase; EntityEelBase.initEntityAI adds EntityAINearestAttackableTarget(EntityPlayer.class).

betteranimalsplus:eel_saltwater.evidence: betteranimalsplus-1.12.2-9.0.1.jar: EntitySaltwaterEel extends EntityEelBase; EntityEelBase.initEntityAI adds EntityAINearestAttackableTarget(EntityPlayer.class).

betteranimalsplus:moose.note: Large animal that attacks players on sight.

iceandfire:deathworm.evidence: IceAndFireRotN-1.9.1-1.2.1.jar: EntityDeathWorm constructor adds DeathWormAITarget(EntityLivingBase.class, EntityDeathWorm$1). EntityDeathWorm$1.apply: when not tamed (func_70909_n), the target must be an EntityAnimal or EntityPlayer (or anything, with config deathWormAttackMonsters), alive, and not the owner (func_152114_e).
iceandfire:deathworm.note: Desert sand worm; large variants are lethal early. Avoid deserts at first.

iceandfire:firedragon.evidence: IceAndFireRotN-1.9.1-1.2.1.jar: EntityFireDragon extends EntityDragonBase. EntityDragonBase.initEntityAI (func_184651_r) adds DragonAITargetNonTamed(EntityPlayer.class, EntityDragonBase$1), and EntityDragonBase$1.apply(player) = DragonUtils.canHostilesTarget(player) && !player.isCreative() (func_184812_l_). A second task, DragonAITarget(EntityLivingBase.class, EntityDragonBase$2), targets other living entities.
iceandfire:firedragon.note: Ice and Fire dragon: very large, flies and breathes fire/ice. Untamed dragons hunt players. Avoid; do not fight in the early game.

iceandfire:icedragon.evidence: IceAndFireRotN-1.9.1-1.2.1.jar: EntityIceDragon extends EntityDragonBase. EntityDragonBase.initEntityAI (func_184651_r) adds DragonAITargetNonTamed(EntityPlayer.class, EntityDragonBase$1), and EntityDragonBase$1.apply(player) = DragonUtils.canHostilesTarget(player) && !player.isCreative() (func_184812_l_). A second task, DragonAITarget(EntityLivingBase.class, EntityDragonBase$2), targets other living entities.
iceandfire:icedragon.note: Ice and Fire dragon: very large, flies and breathes fire/ice. Untamed dragons hunt players. Avoid; do not fight in the early game.

iceandfire:if_cockatrice.evidence: IceAndFireRotN-1.9.1-1.2.1.jar: EntityCockatrice.initEntityAI adds CockatriceAITarget(EntityLivingBase.class, EntityCockatrice$1) at bytecode 253 (183 is CockatriceAITargetItems, item targeting). EntityCockatrice$1.apply returns true for an EntityPlayer (bytecode 38 -> 52 -> 59) unless it is an Animania chicken. CockatriceAITarget's own conditions were not inspected.
iceandfire:if_cockatrice.note: Cockatrice: its stare petrifies or withers. Do not look at it or fight it early.

iceandfire:seaserpent.evidence: IceAndFireRotN-1.9.1-1.2.1.jar: EntitySeaSerpent (extends EntityAnimal) initEntityAI adds FlyingAITarget(EntityLivingBase.class) with no predicate; EntityPlayer is an EntityLivingBase. FlyingAITarget's own shouldExecute was not inspected.
iceandfire:seaserpent.note: Very large ocean serpent. Avoid deep ocean.

mod_lavacow:salamander.evidence: Fish's Undead Rising-1.3.2.jar: EntitySalamander.initEntityAI adds EntityAITargetNonTamed(EntityPlayer.class, EntitySalamander$1); the predicate was not inspected.

mod_lavacow:scarecrow.evidence: Fish's Undead Rising-1.3.2.jar: EntityScarecrow (func_175456_n, applyEntityAI) adds EntityAITargetNonTamed(EntityPlayer.class, EntityScarecrow$1); the predicate was not inspected.

mod_lavacow:unburied.evidence: Fish's Undead Rising-1.3.2.jar: EntityUnburied (func_175456_n, applyEntityAI) adds EntityAINearestAttackableTarget(EntityPlayer.class) with no predicate.

primitivemobs:grovesprite.evidence: primitivemobs-1.2.3a.jar: EntityGroveSprite.onUpdate (func_70071_h_) adds EntityAINearestAttackableTarget(EntityPlayer.class) inside a branch after its tree-log handling (bytecode 436), i.e. only in some state; initEntityAI itself has only EntityAIHurtByTarget.

primitivemobs:lily_lurker.evidence: primitivemobs-1.2.3a.jar: EntityLilyLurker.initEntityAI adds EntityAINearestAttackableTarget(EntityPlayer.class) (and one for EntitySquid).

replacedByMod.description: Vanilla animals that Animania removes and replaces with its own breeds on this pack. The server refuses to spawn or summon them, so the bot will not meet them and scenarios must not expect them. catalog.entity() adds `replacedBy` (with the replacing breeds from the dump, by class package); build-common-mobs.mjs leaves them out. replaceVanillaHorses=false (config/animania.cfg:110), so horses stay.
